description: This ASIM parser supports normalizing Wiz Cloud issues, stored in the WizIssuesV3_CL table, to the ASIM Alert Event normalized schema. WizIssuesV3_CL represents Wiz's unified Issues engine, covering cloud configuration findings, control failures, toxic combinations of risk factors, and correlated threat detections. EventSubType is derived per-row: THREAT_DETECTION issues, and TOXIC_COMBINATION issues whose rule name matches a confirmed-exploit keyword list, are normalized as "Threat". All other issues (cloud configuration/posture findings, control failures, and predictive/reachability-only toxic combinations) are normalized as "Compliance Violation".

configuration, policy, account, file, share, and device audit operations.
Only event_simpleName identifies operations; records with an empty value are excluded.
Unknown event names map to Other. Undocumented numeric enumerations are retained
without guessing their meanings. Missing device or object values remain empty.
Use pack=true to retain original source fields, including currently empty columns.
The source-IP prefix parameter in the filtering parser supports IPv4 prefixes.

parser_title: ASIM Email Event parser for Proofpoint POD messages
description:
Normalizes message inspection records from the CCP connector's ProofpointPODMessage_CL
table to ASIM EmailEvent. Each source message remains one event, including messages
with multiple recipients or MIME parts. Filter disposition is not delivery confirmation.
Connection hosts populate ASIM hostname fields only when they match the expected
hostname formats; IP-shaped or malformed host values are not mislabeled as names.
DMARC quarantine/reject normalize to Fail and retain their policy; pass/none normalize
case-insensitively. DMARC temperror/permerror retain their original value but have no
normalized result because EmailEvent has no matching error enumeration.
Dispositions reject/discard map to Blocked, hold to Quarantined, redirect to Redirected,
and continue/accept/retry to NA without asserting successful delivery.
Live source sampling and schema/data validation are deferred by user direction.
